diane.sec: Notice: Mandatory deprecation of long-lived SSH deploy keys and rollout of SSH Certificate Authority (CA) for all internal deploy users. Starting 2026-10-01 we will begin revoking SSH keys older than 60 days that are used for automation and CI runners unless replaced with CA-signed certs. This reduces risk from leaked private keys and untracked access. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-migration :rotating_light:

infra-bot: ssh-scan report: found 312 deploy keys with last-used >60d, 48 keys without owner metadata, 23 keys shared across multiple services. Top services: infra-deploy, edge-router, legacy-scheduler. Full: https://redwood.internal/reports/ssh-scan-2125009876

diane.sec: Timeline: owner notification window opens 2026-09-10; reminder sweep 2026-09-20; automated revoke of non-CA keys older than 60d starts 2026-10-01. CI/Hosted runners: we will automatically provision short-lived certs for eligible runners. Dedicated/private: we will provide the CA bundle and migration guide but cannot force remote revokes; customers must follow guidance.

nate.platform: how do teams request certs for deploy users or runners? is there an API?

deploy-bot: Cert request CLI (example):
```\n# request a cert for a deploy user, token auth required
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"principal":"deploy-bot@redwood.com","ttl":"24h","purpose":"ci-runner"}' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/infra/ssh/cert-requests
```
Returns a signed cert and expiry. Bulk requests accepted via CSV import.

diane.sec: Example server config snippet to trust our CA (sshd_config):
```
TrustedUserCAKeys /etc/ssh/redwood_ca.pub
AuthenticationMethods publickey
```
And client example to use cert: `ssh -i id_deploy-cert -o CertificateFile=id_deploy-cert user@host`

ellen.sre: our fleet uses a mix of image-based keys baked into AMIs. How do we migrate?

diane.sec: For AMI-baked keys: remove private keys from images, instead provision an init step that requests a short-lived cert from internal CA at boot. We have a helper systemd unit and sample user-data script in the runbook. If you need assistance, open a `ssh-ca-migration` ticket.

infra-bot: Automation note: owners without owner-email metadata will get a DM with remediation steps. We will publish per-team CSVs for platform leads. Command for CSV: `https://api.redwood.internal/infra/ssh-keys?filter=old&format=csv`

nate.platform: will this break existing bastion access or SRE tooling that expects long-lived keys?

diane.sec: Bastion/SRE: you can still use user keys for interactive access, but automation must use certs. If you need a temporary exception for a critical tool, file `sec-exception:ssh` with justification and expiry (max 30 days). Long-term exceptions require GRC approval and compensating controls.

deploy-bot: Quick migration helper for GitHub Actions runner using SSH certs:
```\n- name: Request SSH cert
  run: |
    curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
      -d '{"principal":"ci-runner@github","ttl":"1h","purpose":"ci"}' \
      https://api.redwood.internal/infra/ssh/cert-requests | jq -r .cert > id_rsa-cert
- name: Use cert
  run: |
    ssh -i id_rsa -o CertificateFile=id_rsa-cert deploy@host 'deploy-script.sh'
```

elllen.sre: typo in my earlier msg: will schedule AMI reprovisioning.

diane.sec: Summary checklist for teams:
- Inventory: export CSV and find keys older than 60 days.
- Add owner metadata for any keys you maintain.
- Migrate automation/CI to CA-signed certs or OIDC-based access by 2026-09-20.
- File `ssh-ca-migration` ticket if you need help; `sec-exception:ssh` for temporary holds.

infra-bot: Owners DM schedule: top-150 high-risk keys will be notified between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-12. Full CSV posted to runbook for org admins.

diane.sec: We'll run a dry-run revoke trial on 2026-09-25 (no actual revokes, just a report of what would be disabled). Final enforcement begins 2026-10-01. If you want your team's list earlier ping me or DM deploy-bot. :white_check_mark:
